senses.gloss:
—1 N. of Śiva, the second of the three syllables in ओम्; see अ.
—2 N. of Brahmā.
—3 The orb of the moon; cf. also उर्गौरीपतिरुः कालः सेतुर्नाथः परायणः ।
 नारदोऽर्कोऽनिलः पाशी मार्कण्डेयोऽथ रावणः ॥ Enm. ━ind.
—1 As a particle used expletively; उ उमेशः Sk.
—2 An interjection of:−
——(a) calling; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा पश्चादुमाख्यां सुमुखी जगाम Ku. 1. 26;
——(b) anger;
——(c) compassion;
——(d) command;
——(e) acceptance;
——(f) interrogation; उ मेति मात्रा तपसो निषिद्धा Ku. 1. 26.
——(g) wonder; यत्सन्निधावहमु खाण्डवमग्नयेऽदाम् Bhāg. 1. 15. 8.
 or used merely as an expletive. In the Veda used as an enclitic copula
 implying restriction and emphasis (and, but, on the other hand, now, I
 ask &c.); in classical literature used chiefly with अथ (अथो),
 न ({@नो@}) and किम् (किमु); see these words. उ━उ ▪
 or उत on the one hand━on the other hand, partly━partly.

ऊः [अवतीति, अव-क्विप् ऊठ्]
—1 N. of Śiva.
—2 The moon.
—3 A protector; cf. ऊः परेतोऽण्डजस्त्वष्टा विवस्वानग्निसारथिः । वह्निर्निशाकरः
 पूर्णो दरिद्री सरमाधिपः ॥ Enm. ━ind.
—1 A particle used to introduce a subject.
—2 An interjection of
——(a) calling;
——(b) of compassion;
——(c) protection.
